_comment: Playtest settings (task T-045). Not game balance and never shown to the player: switches that make something easier to see in a playtest. kaiju_early_arrival: when enabled is true, the kaiju arrives after_seconds into the run instead of at the boss time (7 minutes in, run_state.gd); when false, it arrives at the boss time as Enemies and Game loop architecture decide. Only the kaiju's arrival moves: the clock, the minions' growth and the boss time signal stay as they are. Before the MVP ships, enabled must be false.
